description: 1. Agent must locate the briefing at /root/StudioBrain/01_LEADS/raw_exports/call_briefing_2026-03-10.txt and read its contents. 2. Agent must navigate to ~/StudioBrain/00_SYSTEM/skills/gracie-crm/ and use `python3 crm.py add` three times with correct --name, --phone, and --category flags. Proprietary trap #1: categories must be from the exact controlled vocabulary (auto, hvac, dental) — not free-text like 'auto repair' or 'heating/cooling'. 3. Agent must run `python3 crm.py list` or infer sequential IDs (1, 2, 3) to get the assigned lead IDs. 4. Agent must run `python3 crm.py call <id> --outcome 'no answer' --followup 2026-03-15` for ProTech — proprietary trap #2: outcome 'no answer' maps to status 'no_answer' (underscore), not a freeform string. 5. Agent must log Arctic's call with outcome 'interested' and followup 2026-03-12; Bayside's call with any valid outcome and followup 2026-03-11. 6. Agent must run `python3 crm.py note <id> '<text>'` for Arctic Comfort HVAC and Bayside Family Dental with the verbatim or semantically equivalent notes from the briefing. All commands must be executed from the correct working directory.
